en.title: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham Addresses COP31 Climate Summit in Turkiye
en.dek: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham spoke to delegates on 12 November as the COP31 summit in Antalya entered its third day.
facts: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham addressed the summit on 12 November
Delegates from nearly 200 countries are attending the summit
UN chief Antonio Guterres called for a windfall tax on oil and gas firms
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif highlighted Pakistan’s solar power boom
body: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham addressed delegates at the COP31 summit in Antalya on 12 November. According to the BBC and The Guardian, the prime minister spoke as the event entered its third day.

UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called for a windfall tax on oil and gas firms to address climate financing. He stated that failure to act means the world as it is known is over, as reported by the UN and The Guardian.
Guterres also told world leaders that fossil fuels must go the way of the dinosaurs. Africanews and CNA reported that he urged leaders to phase out fossil fuels to address the climate crisis.
New York Times reported Guterres accused the fossil fuel lobby of delaying climate action. He implored climate ambassadors to fight harder during the summit proceedings.
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif highlighted Pakistan’s solar power boom at the summit. According to Dawn, he arrived on 11 November to outline the climate priorities of Pakistan.

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese did not mention fossil fuels in his speech at the summit. The Guardian reported that he focused on renewable energy, though he faced criticism for not addressing the coal industry in Australia.
The summit began with cultural displays, protests, and the trading of pin collectibles. The Straits Times reported that delegates from nearly 200 countries are participating in the event.
en.context: The COP31 climate summit is taking place in Antalya, Turkiye. Delegates from nearly 200 countries are attending to discuss international climate policy and financing.

de.title: Der britische Premierminister Andy Burnham spricht auf dem COP31-Klimagipfel in der Türkei
de.dek: Der britische Premierminister Andy Burnham sprach am 12. November zu den Delegierten, als der COP31-Gipfel in Antalya in seinen dritten Tag ging.
facts: Der britische Premierminister Andy Burnham sprach am 12. November auf dem Gipfel
Delegierte aus fast 200 Ländern nehmen an dem Gipfel teil
UN-Generalsekretär Antonio Guterres forderte eine Übergewinnsteuer für Öl- und Gaskonzerne
Premierminister Shehbaz Sharif hob den Solarenergie-Boom in Pakistan hervor
body: Der britische Premierminister Andy Burnham sprach am 12. November auf dem COP31-Gipfel in Antalya zu den Delegierten. Laut BBC und The Guardian äußerte sich der Premierminister, als die Veranstaltung in ihren dritten Tag ging.

UN-Generalsekretär Antonio Guterres forderte eine Übergewinnsteuer für Öl- und Gaskonzerne, um die Klimafinanzierung zu sichern. Er erklärte, dass ein Versäumnis zu handeln das Ende der Welt, wie wir sie kennen, bedeute, wie von den UN und The Guardian berichtet wurde.

Guterres sagte den Staats- und Regierungschefs zudem, dass fossile Brennstoffe das Schicksal der Dinosaurier teilen müssten. Africanews und CNA berichteten, dass er die Führungskräfte dazu drängte, fossile Brennstoffe auslaufen zu lassen, um die Klimakrise zu bewältigen.

Die New York Times berichtete, Guterres habe die Lobby der fossilen Brennstoffe beschuldigt, Klimaschutzmaßnahmen zu verzögern. Er appellierte an die Klimabotschafter, während des Gipfels entschlossener zu kämpfen.
Premierminister Shehbaz Sharif hob auf dem Gipfel den Solarenergie-Boom in Pakistan hervor. Laut Dawn traf er am 11. November ein, um die Klimaprioritäten Pakistans darzulegen.

Der australische Premierminister Anthony Albanese erwähnte in seiner Rede auf dem Gipfel keine fossilen Brennstoffe. The Guardian berichtete, dass er sich auf erneuerbare Energien konzentrierte, obwohl er dafür kritisiert wurde, die Kohleindustrie in Australien nicht anzusprechen.
Der Gipfel begann mit kulturellen Darbietungen, Protesten und dem Tausch von Anstecknadeln. The Straits Times berichtete, dass Delegierte aus fast 200 Ländern an der Veranstaltung teilnehmen.
de.context: Der COP31-Klimagipfel findet in Antalya, Türkei, statt. Delegierte aus fast 200 Ländern nehmen teil, um über internationale Klimapolitik und Finanzierung zu diskutieren.

Delegates from nearly 200 countries are reported to be attending the summit in Antalya, Turkey.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif highlighted Pakistan’s solar power boom at COP31 in Turkiye. Dawn reports he described it as a revolution by ordinary citizens.

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese faced criticism at the summit for avoiding mention of fossil fuels in his speech. The Guardian reports his speech focused on renewables but was criticised for not addressing the nation’s huge coal industry.
The COP31 climate summit kicked off in Turkey with cultural displays, protests and pin collectibles, according to The Straits Times.
The summit brings together delegates from nearly 200 countries to discuss climate priorities and action.
Reactions to the summit's opening have been mixed, with accusations of delay from UN leadership and differing national priorities on display.

es.body: El primer ministro británico, Andy Burnham, se dirigió a los delegados en la cumbre COP31 en Antalya el 12 de noviembre. Según The Guardian y la BBC, el primer ministro habló mientras la cumbre entraba en su tercer día.

it.body: Il segretario generale dell'ONU Antonio Guterres ha invitato i leader mondiali a far finire i combustibili fossili come i dinosauri. Africanews e CNA hanno riportato l'appello all'azione climatica urgente tenutosi al summit in Turchia.
it.headline: Antonio Guterres invita i leader a eliminare i combustibili fossili alla COP31

ja.body: アントニオ・グテーレス国連事務総長は、世界の指導者たちに対し、化石燃料は恐竜と同じ道をたどらなければならないと述べた。アフリカニュースとCNAは、トルコでの首脳会議で緊急の気候行動を求めるこの呼び掛けをいずれも報じた。
ja.headline: 国連事務総長、COP31で化石燃料の段階的廃止を首脳に要請

ko.body: 안토니우 구테흐스 유엔 사무총장은 세계 각국 지도자들에게 화석연료가 공룡처럼 사라져야 한다고 말했다. 아프리카뉴스와 CNA는 튀르키예에서 열린 정상회의에서 나온 이 같은 긴급 기후행동 촉구를 모두 보도했다.
ko.headline: 유엔 사무총장, COP31서 각국 지도자에 화석연료 단계적 퇴출 촉구

pt.body: O secretário-geral da ONU, António Guterres, disse aos líderes mundiais que os combustíveis fósseis têm de seguir o caminho dos dinossauros. Africanews e CNA relataram ambos o apelo a uma ação climática urgente na cimeira em Turquia.
pt.headline: Secretário-geral da ONU insta líderes a eliminar progressivamente combustíveis fósseis na COP31

zh.body: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯告诉世界各国领导人，化石燃料必须像恐龙一样退出历史舞台。非洲新闻台和亚洲新闻台均报道了此次在土耳其举行的峰会上发出的紧急气候行动呼吁。
zh.headline: 联合国秘书长在COP31敦促各国领导人逐步淘汰化石燃料

sources.title: World leaders face pressure to act at COP31 as climate warnings intensify
UN chief urges world leaders to tackle fossil fuels at COP31

de.body: Premierminister Shehbaz Sharif hob Pakistan-Solarboom bei der COP31 in der Türkei hervor. Premier Shehbaz trifft auf die COP31-Alanya-Gipfelkonferenz, Dawn. Anthony Albanese hatte Regierungschefs vorgeworfen, sie foküsierten sich allein auf Erneuerbare, wird aber kritisiert, dass er das riesige Kohle-Industrie des Landes nicht angeht, The Guardian.
de.headline: Pakistan-Solar-Boom im Fokus bei COP31

en.body: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif highlighted Pakistan’s solar power boom at COP31 in Turkiye. PM Shehbaz arrives at COP31 Antalya Leaders' Summit, Dawn. Anthony Albanese said governments had a sole focus on renewables but is criticised for not addressing the nation’s huge coal industry, The Guardian.
en.headline: Pakistan's solar power boom highlighted at COP31

es.body: El primer ministro Shehbaz Sharif destacó el auge de la energía solar de Pakistán en la COP31 en Turquía. Shehbaz Sharif llega a la Cumbre de Líderes de la COP31 en Antalya, según Dawn. Anthony Albanese afirmó que los gobiernos tenían un único enfoque en las renovables, pero es criticado por no abordar la enorme industria del carbón del país, según The Guardian.
es.headline: El auge de la energía solar de Pakistán en el centro de COP31

fr.body: Le Premier ministre Shehbaz Sharif a mis en avant le boom solaire du Pakistan à la COP31 en Turquie. M. Shehbaz arrive au sommet des dirigeants de la COP31 à Antalya. Dawn. Anthony Albanese a déclaré que les gouvernements n'avaient pour seul objectif que les énergies renouvelables, mais est critiqué pour ne pas avoir abordé l'industrie charbonnière massive du pays, The Guardian.
fr.headline: Le boom solaire pakistanais mis en lumière à la COP31

it.body: Il primo ministro Shehbaz Sharif ha evidenziato il boom dell'energia solare pakistana alla COP31 in Turchia. Shehbaz Sharif arriva al summit dei leader della COP31 ad Antalya. Anthony Albanese ha affermato che i governi hanno un focus esclusivo sulle rinnovabili, ma è stato criticato per non aver affrontato l'enorme industria del carbone del paese, The Guardian.
it.headline: Il boom dell'energia solare pakistana al centro di COP31

ja.body: シャバズ・シャリフ首相は、トルコで開かれたCOP31でパキスタンの太陽光発電ブームを強調した。シャバズ首相がCOP31アンタルヤ首脳サミットに到着（ドーン）。アンソニー・アルバネジは、政府が再生可能エネルギーにのみ注力していると述べたが、同国の巨大な石炭産業への対応を怠っていると批判されている（ガーディアン）。
ja.headline: パキスタンの太陽光発電ブーム、COP31で強調

ko.body: 셰바즈 샤리프 총리가 튀르키예에서 열린 COP31에서 파키스탄의 태양광 발전 붐을 부각시켰다. 셰바즈 총리가 COP31 안탈리아 지도자 정상회의에 도착했다고 던이 전했다. 앤서니 앨버니지는 정부들이 재생에너지에만 초점을 맞추고 있다고 말했지만, 국가의 거대한 석탄 산업 문제를 다루지 않는다는 비판을 받고 있다고 가디언이 보도했다.
ko.headline: COP31에서 주목받은 파키스탄 태양광 발전 붐

pt.body: O primeiro-ministro do Paquistão, Shehbaz Sharif, destacou o boom da energia solar do país no COP31, na Turquia. Shehbaz Sharif chega ao COP31 Antália Leaders' Summit, Dawn. Anthony Albanese disse que os governos têm um foco exclusivo nas renováveis, mas é criticado por não abordar a enorme indústria de carvão do país, The Guardian.
pt.headline: Aumento da energia solar em destaque no COP31

zh.body: 巴基斯坦总理谢巴兹·谢里夫在土耳其COP31会议上突出了该国太阳能热潮。谢巴兹总理抵达安塔利亚领导人峰会，引用《黎明报》。安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯表示，各国政府只关注可再生能源，但因未解决该国庞大的煤炭产业而受到批评，引用《卫报》。
zh.headline: 巴基斯坦在COP31备受关注的太阳能热潮

sources.title: PM Shehbaz highlights Pakistan's solar 'revolution by ordinary citizens' at COP31
Anthony Albanese fails to mention fossil fuels in Cop summit speech

de.body: Guterres sagt, die Welt müsse auf der COP31 härter kämpfen. Laut Al Jazeera beschuldigte er die fossile Brennstofflobby, Klimaschutz zu verzögern. Die New York Times berichtet, er habe Klimabotschafter beschworen, härter zu kämpfen.
de.headline: UN-Generalsekretär Guterres wirft der fossilen Brennstofflobby Verzögerung von Klimaschutz vor

en.body: Guterres says the world must fight harder at COP31. According to Al Jazeera, he accused the fossil fuel lobby of delaying climate action. New York Times reports he implored climate ambassadors to fight harder.
en.headline: UN chief Guterres accuses fossil fuel lobby of delaying climate action

es.body: Guterres afirma que el mundo debe luchar más en la COP31. Según Al Jazeera, acusó al lobby de combustibles fósiles de retrasar la acción climática. El New York Times informa que instó a los embajadores climáticos a luchar con mayor intensidad.
es.headline: El secretario general de la ONU, Guterres, acusa al lobby de combustibles fósiles de retrasar la acción climática

fr.body: Guterres affirme que le monde doit lutter davantage à la COP31. Selon Al Jazeera, il a accusé le lobby des combustibles fossiles de retarder l'action climatique. Le New York Times rapporte qu'il a imploré les ambassadeurs climatiques de lutter davantage.
fr.headline: Guterres accuse le lobby des combustibles fossiles de retarder l'action climatique

it.body: Guterres afferma che il mondo deve lottare di più alla COP31. Secondo Al Jazeera, ha accusato il lobby dei combustibili fossili di ritardare l'azione climatica. Il New York Times riferisce che ha esortato gli ambasciatori climatici a impegnarsi di più.
it.headline: Il segretario generale dell'ONU Guterres accusa il lobby dei combustibili fossili di rallentare l'azione climatica

ja.body: グテレス氏はCOP31で世界はより一層努力すべきだと述べた。アルジャジーラによると、同氏は化石燃料ロビーが気候変動対策を遅らせていると非難した。ニューヨーク・タイムズは、同氏が気候変動大使らに一層の努力を訴えたと報じた。
ja.headline: グテレス国連事務総長、化石燃料ロビーが気候変動対策を遅らせていると非難

ko.body: 구테흐스 사무총장은 COP31에서 세계가 더욱 적극적으로 나서야 한다고 말했다. 알자지라에 따르면, 그는 화석연료 로비가 기후 행동을 지연시키고 있다고 비판했다. 뉴욕타임스는 그가 기후 대사들에게 더욱 적극적으로 움직일 것을 촉구했다고 전했다.
ko.headline: 구테흐스 유엔 사무총장, 화석연료 로비가 기후 행동 지연시킨다고 비판

pt.body: Guterres diz que o mundo deve lutar com mais determinação na COP31. Segundo a Al Jazeera, acusou o lobby dos combustíveis fósseis de atrasar a ação climática. O New York Times relata que ele implorou aos embaixadores climáticos que lutassem com mais determinação.
pt.headline: Chefe da ONU, Guterres, acusa lobby dos combustíveis fósseis de atrasar ação climática

zh.body: 古特雷斯表示，世界必须在COP31上更加努力。据半岛电视台报道，他指责化石燃料游说团体拖延气候行动。《纽约时报》报道称，他恳请气候大使们更加努力。
zh.headline: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯指责化石燃料游说团体拖延气候行动

sources.title: PM Shehbaz joins world leaders at COP31, will outline Pakistan’s climate priorities
‘Fight Harder,’ U.N. Chief António Guterres Implores, Rousing Climate Ambassadors at COP31

de.body: Premierminister Shehbaz Sharif ist auf dem COP31-Gipfeltreffen in Antalya in der Türkei eingetroffen. Laut Dawn will er Pakistans Klimaprioritäten hervorheben. Berichten zufolge nehmen Delegierte aus fast 200 Ländern teil.
de.headline: Premierminister Shehbaz auf COP31-Gipfeltreffen in Antalya eingetroffen

en.body: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived at the COP31 Antalya Leaders' Summit in Turkiye. According to Dawn, he is set to highlight Pakistan’s climate priorities. Delegates from nearly 200 countries are reported to be attending.
en.headline: PM Shehbaz arrives at COP31 Antalya Leaders' Summit

es.body: El primer ministro Shehbaz Sharif llegó a la Cumbre de Líderes de la COP31 en Antalya, Turquía. Según Dawn, está previsto que destaque las prioridades climáticas de Pakistán. Se reporta que asisten delegados de casi 200 países.
es.headline: El primer ministro Shehbaz llega a la Cumbre de Líderes de la COP31 en Antalya

fr.body: Le Premier ministre Shehbaz Sharif est arrivé au sommet des dirigeants de la COP31 à Antalya, en Turquie. Selon Dawn, il doit souligner les priorités climatiques du Pakistan. On rapporte la présence de délégués de près de 200 pays.
fr.headline: M. Shehbaz arrive au sommet des dirigeants de la COP31 à Antalya

it.body: Il primo ministro Shehbaz Sharif è arrivato al vertice dei leader della COP31 ad Antalya, in Turchia. Secondo Dawn, dovrebbe evidenziare le priorità climatiche del Pakistan. Sono segnalati partecipanti da quasi 200 paesi.
it.headline: Il premier Shehbaz arriva al vertice dei leader della COP31 ad Antalya

ja.body: シャバズ・シャリフ首相はトルコのCOP31アンタリア首脳サミットに到着した。ドーンによると、同氏はパキスタンの気候変動対策の優先事項を強調する予定だ。約200カ国の代表が出席すると報じられている。
ja.headline: シャバズ・シャリフ首相、COP31アンタリア首脳サミットに到着

ko.body: 셰바즈 샤리프 총리가 튀르키예에서 열린 COP31 안탈리아 지도자 정상회의에 도착했다. 던에 따르면, 그는 파키스탄의 기후 우선순위를 부각시킬 예정이다. 약 200개국 대표단이 참석하는 것으로 전해졌다.
ko.headline: 셰바즈 총리, COP31 안탈리아 지도자 정상회의 도착

pt.body: O primeiro-ministro Shehbaz Sharif chegou à Cimeira de Líderes da COP31 em Antália, na Turquia. Segundo o Dawn, deverá destacar as prioridades climáticas do Paquistão. Delegados de quase 200 países deverão participar, segundo relatos.
pt.headline: Primeiro-ministro Shehbaz chega à Cimeira de Líderes da COP31 em Antália

zh.body: 总理夏巴兹·谢里夫抵达在土耳其举行的COP31安塔利亚领导人峰会。据《黎明报》报道，他将重点阐述巴基斯坦的气候优先事项。据报道，来自近200个国家的代表将出席。
zh.headline: 总理夏巴兹抵达COP31安塔利亚领导人峰会
